steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Hey there, dear viewers! Coming to you live from the heart of the Public Security Bureau, we've got the latest scoop on the jaw-dropping case that's rocked Eastside—How the High-Profile Heist Hits Business Tycoon's Antique Vault.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Sheriff, good to see you. Do we have any solid leads on this case? Any suspects in the crosshairs...?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Um...
Ding—
The video feed featuring the Sheriff's awkward pause is abruptly cut off by a pop-up alert on the screen.

Emergency Alert:
Red Alert! Code Red! I've got something mega, ultra, life-or-death important that I need to talk to you about ASAP!
—Christina

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You made it, finally! I've been on pins and needles waiting for you!
As soon as you walk into the interrogation room, Christina practically leaps out of her seat and bolts over to you.
She yanks your arm and hauls you in front of a desk at the center of the room. The once-spotless desk is now a landscape of paper mountains, a mess of documents and files.
Is this...?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Got the case files from the Public Security Bureau, and you bet I've combed through every last one. Sorted them by how crucial, pressing, and sketchy they are.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yep, knew they'd be lost without me. A few months out, and the place is swamped with unsolved mysteries.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But hey, as Eastside's numero uno detective and the go-to lifesaver for my coworkers, it's on me to untangle these knotty puzzles they can't crack!
So you've been cooped up in your room all this while, just to focus on this?
You inquire, putting on a shocked face.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Are you kidding me? You're seriously underestimating my game. Knocked this out in a week, easy! Before that, I was digging into...
She halts mid-sentence, catching your eye as if she's just spilled the beans. She bites her lip, clearly irritated, and says stiffly:

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Just some ancient history, no big deal.

You're well aware of what those "ancient histories" she's avoiding talking about really are. Even since landing at MBCC, Christina hasn't been able to shake off her hang-ups about Shalom. She's been on a mission to dig up the dirt on that elusive Hush.
The case files strewn across the desk are actually a diversion, a strategy you've implemented by quietly liaising with the Public Security Bureau.
You making any headway on that old skeleton in your closet?
You inquire with great caution. Christina displays a faint sneer, softly murmuring.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yeah, right. If only digging up dirt on someone was a walk in the park...
Christina, I'm here for you if you ever need someone to talk to or a helping hand.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I get it, isn't that why I'm here in the first place?
She casts a meaningful glance at the disordered heap of case files strewn across her desk. She is clearly trying to change the topic.
Perhaps this is not the moment for such discussions.
Noting the palpable tension and caution in her gaze, you silently exhale a breath of resignation. Any attempt to coerce her into speaking would undoubtedly yield counterproductive results.
So you decide to follow her topic.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Okay, so what's the big deal you were hyping up in your SOS?
Noticing that you've decided not to probe any further, she appears to let out a subtle sigh of relief. She then gestures toward a particular stack amid the small hills of case files to your left.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You need to look at this.

You saw it coming. The Public Security Bureau has been up to their necks dealing with the antique theft investigation, leaving them little time for case selection. So they've likely lumped all the recent low-priority reports and dumped them here.
Still, as you start to delve into the contents of the case files, your facial expression shifts to one of nuanced bewilderment.

A domestic squabble at the Fernley Manor? Eerie noises haunting Inkborough in the dead of night? A celebrity contralto on Sceptentine Street missing her personal photo collection? Some tipsy suburbanite swearing he spotted a luminous, unidentified creature of the canine variety?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Uh? Oh, whoops, my bad—wrong pile. These are the ones that are kinda sketchy but not exactly red-alert material. The real do-or-die stuff is that one over there, heh.
With a touch of awkwardness, she scratches her head and subtly shifts her fingers to indicate another document adjacent to her.
For a moment, you find yourself at a loss for words, internally questioning the significance of these seemingly trivial details. Nonetheless, you proceed to lift the pertinent case file.
As you unveil the cover, your eyes meet an oversized inscription: "The Great Cat Heist"—
A cat café in Eastside was victim to a burglary during the early morning hours three days prior, and three cats were abducted by the criminals?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You got it. This case is a real head-scratcher. Start by checking out the CCTV footage we pulled from the cat café.

In the dead of night, precisely at 2:15 a.m., a tall, slender young man materializes before the glass door of the cat café. Ensuring he is unobserved, he deftly retrieves a toolkit from his pocket and commences the delicate art of lock-picking. After ten minutes, the lock finally acquiesces.

Upon crossing the threshold, his eyes dart to the overhead security camera before he unerringly navigates to a secluded corner: the sanctuary for the café's feline residents. With a flick of his wrist, the latch is undone, and he steps into the realm of the cats.

Once inside, the man finds himself instantly besieged by a small clowder of cats. With discerning eyes, he singles out one feline and sets it beyond the enclosure's boundary. Navigating a minefield of strewn toys and food dishes, he advances to a dim corner where two other cats are lost in slumber.

He scoops them into his arms with minimal disturbance. As he prepares to make his exit, another cat trails behind him only to be returned to its confines by the man. Sealing the enclosure, he cradles the trio of chosen cats and departs the café as the clock strikes 2:30 a.m.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Playback's over. Spot anything fishy?
This guy's a weird one... Don't your typical burglars usually go incognito? You know, a mask or a hat, something to hide their mug.
Christina gives a nod of approval.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: That's right. Usually, crooks go to great lengths to disguise their looks when they're pulling a job, just to throw us off the scent. But this fella? No mask, no hat, nothing.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Heck, he even eyeballed the camera, like he's daring us: "Hey, I'm Henry! Come get me if you dare!"
Henry, you say? So you've got a bead on this guy already?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yep, had some friends over at the Public Security Bureau do a facial scan. He's got a rap sheet, so he popped up right away.
As she speaks, she opens a folder next to her and hands it to you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Take a look, Henry's dossier. Freshly sent over just 30 minutes ago.
Henry's a high school dropout, jobless wanderer, no next of kin, scraping by on government handouts and random gig work at a corner store. Even has a history of getting into scraps.
...His profile checks all the boxes of a typical crook.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: And trust me, nabbing those cats wasn't some last-minute whim; it was clearly preplanned.
Preplanned?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Did you catch that? When he made eye contact with the camera, he didn't even have to look around for it. Knew exactly where it was. And when he got into the kitty playground, the guy popped that latch like he’d done it a hundred times.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: He knows that café like the back of his hand; definitely did his homework before making his move.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Another thing, the cats in there didn't seem to mind him one bit. That's not typical cat behavior for an intruder in their turf at that hour. So they've got to know him at least.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Looks like he's put in some solid groundwork to get on their good side.
You ponder for a moment.
Speaking of cats...
Snatching cats? That's pretty out there, especially when there's pricier stuff in the café... So, you think he's in it for the cats, not the cash?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Heh, look at you, detective-in-the-making! You're right on the money with my own thoughts!
At this point, Christina snaps her fingers in delight.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: We can't say it's a surefire thing, but odds are, you're right.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: He didn't just grab any cats; he had his eye on those three specifically. One other cat tried to tag along, but he didn't just sweep it up—put it right back where it came from.
What's he after, then?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah, that's the million-dollar question! And it's up to yours truly, the Chief Detective, to dig it up and lay it bare!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ahem, so we're still in the dark about what drives this guy, but one thing's for sure—the cats are no ordinary felines. Crack that mystery, and we're a hop, skip, and a jump away from busting this case wide open.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But let's not forget, we're dealing with a loose cannon with a violent past. No telling what he might do to those helpless kitties. So, chop-chop, sign off on my field trip request, will ya?

Shelving her earlier enthusiasm and self-satisfaction from her investigative zeal, she locks eyes with you, her expression now solemn. With deliberate care, she sifts through the chaotic mound of papers strewn across her desk to unearth a form that had been prepped in advance.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: So, my deep dive's got you clued in on how critical this is, yeah? I've got a full-blown game plan ready to roll. The clock's ticking, and every tick puts those hostages in deeper trouble. Time's of the essence for this rescue mission!
She pauses for a moment.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Uh... did I say "hostages"? Feline hostages?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Whatever, semantics. The point is, we've gotta get those cats outta harm's way, and slap some cuffs on that no-good catnapper!
With a surge of righteous fury, she clenches her fists tightly, her arm casting a forceful swing into the void, as though to deliver justice to a nefarious villain absent from the scene.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hmph, any jerk who dares to harm innocent, adorable critters is totally, totally, totally unforgivable!
Christina's spirited and energetic demeanor brings you some comfort.
It seems that your "tactic of delay" worked. At least for now, she is fully engrossed in the "Great Kitty Caper," momentarily shelving the concerns that have been gnawing at her.
So you promptly take the form and sign your name.

steps.speaker: You
steps.content: Of course, no problem. How could I, a humble chief, stand in the way of a great detective cracking a case...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yay!!!
Before you can get a word in edgewise, she bursts into cheers. You have no choice but to clear your throat and cut in:
But I have a condition—I have to go with you.
Her excitedly waving arm is still suspended in mid-air.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hmm? You're also going?
You nod.

Christina bears faint dark circles beneath her eyes, her visage still carrying traces of fatigue. It might be the residue of her tireless delve into bygone matters, or the recent nocturnal hours spent organizing case files.
Regardless of the cause, considering her present state, it's unthinkable to allow her to venture out alone.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I didn't think you were into this kind of stuff...
She caresses her chin in thought for a good while before she finally manages to release a hesitant sigh.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Alright. Since you managed to answer fairly well just now, I'll begrudgingly let you tag along on this case as a temporary little assistant!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But just to be clear, solving cases isn't child's play, you have to follow my lead, got it? No going off on your own, otherwise, I can't ensure your safety...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Oh, and don’t forget, you’re just a temporary sidekick! You're on probation till you prove your worth. And just a heads up, I run a tight ship!
Observing her bend her fingers, earnestly establishing the ground rules with you, a smile surfaces on your face.
Alright, I'll follow the grand detective's orders to a T.
